content:
Według Jose Mourinho nie.

Sterling, który opuścił sąd bez komentarza, otrzymał nakaz odbycia 100 godzin bezpłatnej pracy i zakaz prowadzenia pojazdów na 24 miesiące.

title: Sterling given suspended jail sentence for dangerous driving
summary:
Raheem Sterling pleaded guilty at Basingstoke Magistrates' Court in September and admitted possession of six nitrous oxide cannisters for wrongful inhalation and failing to provide a specimen
Former England pla
content:
Raheem Sterling pleaded guilty at Basingstoke Magistrates' Court in September and admitted possession of six nitrous oxide cannisters for wrongful inhalation and failing to provide a specimen Former England player Raheem Sterling has been given a suspended 12-month jail sentence for dangerous driving and possession of nitrous oxide after a crash involving a Lamborghini on the motorway.

Sterling pleaded guilty at Basingstoke Magistrates' Court in September to driving a Lamborghini Urus dangerously on the M25, the M3, the A327 and Minley Road before he crashed on May 28.

The sentence is suspended for 18 months.

He has also been handed a two-year driving ban and must undertake 100 hours of unpaid community work.

content:
Borussia Dortmund striker Serhou Guirassy believes he belongs among the world's top five forwards and has not ruled out winning the Ballon d'Or.

In an interview with “Bild”, the 30-year-old also opened up about his relationship with Fábio Silva and his future at the Bundesliga club.

Asked whether he receives enough recognition, Guirassy made a confident assessment of his position in world football.

"If you look at the last three or four years, there are strikers like Kane and Mbappé – and I would say that I might be fourth or fifth," he explained.

The Dortmund forward also believes the Ballon d'Or is within reach, despite finishing 21st in the 2025 voting.

title: Genoa defender Ostigard spends night in hospital with high fever
summary: GENOA, ITALY - AUGUST 22: Leo Ostigard of Genoa controls the ball under pressure from Rasmus Hojlund of Napoli during the Serie A match between Genoa CFC and SSC Napoli at Stadio Luigi Ferraris on August 22, 20
content:
GENOA, ITALY - AUGUST 22: Leo Ostigard of Genoa controls the ball under pressure from Rasmus Hojlund of Napoli during the Serie A match between Genoa CFC and SSC Napoli at Stadio Luigi Ferraris on August 22, 2026 in Genoa, Italy.

(Photo by Simone Arveda/Getty Images) Genoa defender Leo Ostigard spent Monday night in hospital after suffering a sudden high fever, although tests have since ruled out anything serious.

According to ANSA, the Norway international was taken to Genoa’s San Martino Hospital in the early hours, after the fever came with a severe headache.

He was examined by infectious disease specialist Professor Matteo Bassetti and his team.

The routine diagnostic tests came back reassuring and ruled out any significant medical problems.
